Google Ads

Capture relevant demand and measure the complete funnel.

GAOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Google Ads supports paid acquisition through eligible search and other advertising campaign types. MoreSpace can map customer intent to a reviewed campaign structure, connect suitable landing pages, and align conversion measurement with qualified leads, purchases, and the sales process.

Useful outputs

  • Named campaign structures with controlled targeting and budgets
  • Tested conversion measurements and reviewed lead-feedback mappings
  • Spend, conversion-quality, and commercial outcome dashboards

Where we can apply it

  • Intent research → campaign structure → reviewed search ad → qualified enquiry.
  • Form submission → validated conversion event → CRM qualification → feedback report.
  • Advertising spend → customer records → revenue reconciliation → CAC and ROAS review.
01

Use case 1

Organize search campaigns around relevant intent, offers, and service locations.

02

Use case 2

Connect eligible conversion events and lead qualification feedback with reporting.

03

Use case 3

Compare campaign spend with qualified pipeline and customer acquisition costs.

Inputs we need

  • Approved target markets, search themes, and advertising budget
  • Relevant landing pages, reviewed copy, and offer definitions
  • Conversion events, customer values, and CRM qualification rules

Delivery sequence

  • Agree the customer intent, campaign objective, and meaningful conversion definition.
  • Build reviewed campaigns and test tagging, destinations, and conversion signals.
  • Launch within approved budgets and inspect search relevance and qualified outcomes.

Expert review points

  • Approve keyword scope, ad claims, landing pages, and spending limits.
  • Reconcile reported conversions with CRM outcomes and attribution settings.
